 PRIVATE HIGHER EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTIONS ACT 1996

PRIVATE HIGHER EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTIONS (COMPOUNDING OF OFFENCES)

(AMENDMENT) REGULATIONS 2017

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 88 of the Private Higher Educational

Institutions Act 1996 [Act 555], the Minister makes the following regulations:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Private Higher Educational

Institutions (Compounding of Offences) (Amendment) Regulations 2017.

(2) These Regulations come into operation on 28 November 2017.

Amendment of regulation 4

2. Regulation 4 of the Private Higher Educational Institutions (Compounding of

Offences) Regulations 1997 [P.U. (A) 548/1997], which are referred to as the

"principal Regulations" in these Regulations, is amended by substituting for

subregulation (2) the following subregulation:

"(2) Payment of the amount specified in the offer shall be made by bank draft.".

Substitution of First Schedule

3. The principal Regulations are amended by substituting for the First Schedule the

following Schedule:

"FIRST SCHEDULE

[Regulation 2]

COMPOUNDABLE OFFENCES

1. Offences committed under the provisions of the Act:

(a) subsection 15(7);

(b) subsection 28(3);

(c) subsection 30(4);

(d) subsection 31(5);

(e) subsection 33A(4);

(f) subsection 33A(5);

(g) subsection 40(2);

(h) subsection 47(6);

(i) subsection 51(8);

(j) subsection 60(5);

(k) paragraph 66(4)(a);

(l) paragraph 66(4)(b);

(m) paragraph 70(6)(a);

(n) paragraph 70(6)(b);

(o) paragraph 70(6)(c);

(p) subsection 72(2);

(q) subsection 73(4);

(r) section 75;

(s) section 78;

(t) paragraph 81(1)(a);

(u) paragraph 81(1)(b);

(v) paragraph 81(1)(c);

(w) paragraph 81(1)(d);

(x) paragraph 81(1)(e);

(y) paragraph 81(1)(f); and

(z) section 82.

2. Offences committed under the provisions of the Private Higher Educational

Institutions (Permit to Teach) Regulations 2017 [P.U. (A) 360/2017]:

(a) subregulation 7(5);

(b) subregulation 10(2); and

(c) subregulation 11(2).".

Substitution of Second Schedule

4. The principal Regulations are amended by substituting for the Second Schedule

the following Schedule:

"SECOND SCHEDULE

[Regulation 3]

FORM A

OFFER TO COMPOUND AN OFFENCE

 Reference No.:____________________

To:

________________________________________

________________________________________

________________________________________

Sir/Madam,

OFFER TO COMPOUND AN OFFENCE

A complaint has been made that you have committed the following offence

under______________________________________________________________________________________________

Date: _______________________________ Time: _______________________________________________________

Place: ______________________________________________________________________________________________

Offence: ___________________________________________________________________________________________

_____________________________________________________________________________________________________

____________________________________________________________________________________________________

2. You are notified that by the virtue of the powers conferred on me by section 86 of

the Private Higher Educational Institutions Act 1996 and with the written consent of the

Public Prosecutor, you are offered a compound for the offence stated above for the sum

of Ringgit Malaysia ________________________________________________(RM_______________________).

If this offer is accepted, payment shall be made by bank draft

to the Registrar General within ________________________________________ ( ) days from the

date of receipt of this letter.

3. The offer to compound this offence will lapse upon the expiry of the period

referred to in paragraph 2. If payment of the sum stated above has not been made

within that period, prosecution may be instituted against you without further notice.

 Official Stamp

_________________________________________ ________________________________

(Signature of Registrar General) (Date)".
